questions: Loosely based on the 19th-century Italian tale of a living wooden puppet, this 2023 Soulslike action RPG casts players as a rebellious automaton navigating a Belle Époque-inspired fictional city — what is it?
Lies of P is a 2023 action role-playing game developed by Neowiz and Round8 Studio and published by Neowiz.
Turning colorless in acid and a fuchsia pink in base, this phthalein dye is a favorite indicator for acid-base titrations — what is it?
Phenolphthalein: pH indicator that turns pink in basic solution.
Known for a bass technique mixing tapping, flamenco-style strumming, and slapping, this musician fronted the supergroup Oysterhead alongside Trey Anastasio and Stewart Copeland — who is he?
Les Claypool (born September 29, 1963) is an American musician, best known as the founder, lead singer, bassist, and primary songwriter of Primus.
Largest of the four by area — which one?
Munich has the greatest area of the four (311 km2).
Chola dynasty (founded 300 BC) is the earliest of the four.
This retired wrestler, who competed under a ring name borrowed from his famous wrestling father, won both the WCW United States and World Tag Team Championships — who is he?
In what year was Baskin-Robbins founded?
Baskin-Robbins: American multinational ice cream parlor chain.
